# MCM Export Format Baseline

Apply this project-specific baseline whenever `write-mcm-paper` is active.

- US Letter portrait (8.5 × 11 in); one-column English paper; **2.54 cm top, bottom, left, and right margins**; Times New Roman 12 pt body; single spacing; justified paragraphs; 0.25-in first-line indent except titles, captions, table cells, and `where` formula explanations.
- Do not create a header or footer on any page.
- Page 1 has only the title, `Summary`, summary paragraphs, and `Keywords:`. Do not place a summary-sheet label, contest/year/problem/team metadata, border, or table on that page.
- Begin the table of contents on a new page and begin the body on the following new page. Use 0 pt before/after and single spacing for TOC entries; keep it within one page.
- Use genuine Heading 1/2/3 styles for a refreshable TOC. Use 16/14/12 pt bold headings.
- Put `Table n. <title>` immediately above each table and `Figure. n <title>` immediately below each figure. Captions are centered, bold, Palatino 10 pt. Center tables and every table cell.
- Use editable OMML in Word for all formulas, including formulas in table cells. Number display equations consecutively. Follow each display equation with an unindented lowercase `where ...` paragraph.
- Do not indent reference entries. In Problem Restatement, give each task/question its own numbered item. In Assumptions and Justifications, use bold numbered assumptions plus paragraphs, not secondary headings.
- Use the specific text architecture and validation rules in `SKILL.md`; it supersedes older template observations that conflict with this baseline.
